micro_learning.question: Can the full conditional model learn the task with detection and mean retained-normal supervision, and is there early transfer?

micro_learning.conclusion: Full-point ranking learning on the micro training subset is demonstrated and includes few-return and sparse-normal-paired anomalies. Relative-to-initial ranking transfer exists on fixed 201 and real development scopes, with all 19 sequence curves improving AP and FPR95. Transfer detection loss increases and complex-normal false positives remain high. This is one random seed and a micro subset, not evidence isolating mean pairing or sensor conditioning, nor release of full training.

short_learning.conclusion: Broad-pool short learning yields better 201 and real fixed-scope AP/FPR95 than micro 256. At equal 256 updates real ranking improves while 201 worsens; 1024 also increases update budget, so its gains cannot be attributed solely to coverage. Difficult-normal protection remains mixed: 201 sparse false positives decrease, rough and changed-neighborhood false positives increase, and 49 unchanged normals cross upward after insertion at the same checkpoint threshold. This is not a loss or conditioning ablation and does not establish full-val19 performance.
short_learning.decision: Stop at 1024 updates with all evaluations complete. The next bounded mechanism question is mean versus worst retained-normal pairing with identical initialization, requests, budget and scopes, checking normal protection together with recall. Do not automatically execute it or release full formal training.
